enforcer.title: Architecture Enforcer
enforcer.staffing: Existing S00 triage + W05 independent technical review; W06 principal for explicitly escalated architecture
enforcer.model_policy: S00 Instant for deterministic routing; Sol Medium for source/ABI review; Sol High only on owner-approved escalation
enforcer.authority: May block, request evidence, and open a proposal PR in the owning source repository; may not approve, merge, or silently change architecture

proposal.repository: same source repository owning proposed contract; never Studio
proposal.prototype_source_diff: Only if separately authorized, never implicitly
required_sections: Why the existing contract cannot support the feature
Affected owning repositories and file boundaries
proposal.approval: Authenticated owner review and owner merge/explicit acceptance with current source SHA; never label-only or worker self-approval

notes: Architecture changes include changing existing public contracts and ownership rules, even if no new directory/file is created. Static path checks alone cannot prove semantic contract compliance. Independent review verifies classification against the actual diff. S00 cannot grant owner approval; native Work trigger/model activation remains separate.
